description: Search aflink.us for Air Force and DoD websites by name, acronym, URL, category or purpose (for example "mypay", "travel voucher", "leave"). Every word must match. Returns each link's title, URL and category, best matches (title matches) first. Links in the UNOFFICIAL category are third-party sites, not run by the Air Force.

limit.description: Most results to return (default 10, at most 50).

query.description: Words to search for, as you would type them into the aflink.us search box.

name: search_links

official.description: false for links in the UNOFFICIAL (third-party) section

title: Search AF links
